label: Leaking sink
description: Drips, puddles or water damage under or around a sink.

required_shots.prompt: Open the cabinet and show everything under the sink
required_shots.tip: Use your phone light if it's dark under there.
required_shots.hint: The whole cabinet space under the sink: pipes, drain and cabinet floor.

required_shots.prompt: Get close to where the water is coming from
required_shots.tip: Focus on the drip, stain or wet spot.
required_shots.hint: A sharp close-up of the wet spot, drip or joint that leaks.

required_shots.prompt: Show the faucet and sink from above
required_shots.tip: Include the counter, faucet and basin.
required_shots.hint: The faucet, handles and sink basin from above.
required_shots.skip_label: The leak isn't near the faucet

required_shots.prompt: Show the shut-off valves on the pipes
required_shots.tip: They're usually on the pipes under the sink or on the wall.
required_shots.hint: The small valves on the hot and cold supply lines under the sink.

questions.q: Is the water to the sink turned off?
How old is the sink or faucet?

severity_guide: an occasional slow drip, dry cabinet, no damage
a steady drip, or a leak only when the tap runs, with a small wet spot
a constant drip with a wet or stained cabinet floor
a leak that soaks the cabinet, swollen or damaged wood, or water that can't be shut off
constant flow, or water spreading beyond the cabinet (floor, wall, room below)

rules: Describe what is visible; say 'likely' for any cause.
affected_area_m2 is the area of visible water damage (often under 0.5).
